Get Lakes and Rivers

Source: R/geo-themakart.R
geoGewaesser.Rd

Returns the water bodies of the topographic layers of a ThemaKart set: lakes in two size categories, rivers in five. They make thematic maps readable as maps of Switzerland, and lakes explain gaps in maps drawn on the vegetation area.

Usage

geoGewaesser(
  type = c("see", "fluss"),
  category = NULL,
  setYear = NULL,
  crs = 2056,
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

type

"see" for lakes or "fluss" for rivers.

category

integer vector of size categories, 1 being the largest; NULL for all.

setYear

year of the ThemaKart set; see Details.

crs

target CRS. The default harmonises all layers to LV95 (EPSG:2056), since not all layers of a set share one CRS.

cache

logical; if TRUE, results are read from and written to the local cache (see cacheList()).

refresh

logical; if TRUE, the source is queried again even if a cached copy exists.

Value

An sf object with the columns kategorie_n and geometry.

See also

addGewaesser() to draw them.

Other swiss.geometry: geo-boundaries, geoThemakart(), themakartSets()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
lakes <- geoGewaesser("see", category = 1)
} # }
